description: Skull stripping that keeps the input's format, space and grid. Exercises the RFC 0010 inputs.<id> form on every qualifier of a pass-through output, the vendor-prefixed form, and the binary label system on a mask.

image.description: Any head image; SynthStrip is contrast-agnostic.

brain.description: The input with non-brain voxels zeroed, written in the input's own format on the input grid.

mask.description: Binary brain mask on the input grid.

qc.description: A low-resolution preview resampled to a vendor-named space for a QA page.
